facts.fact: El Obeid Criminal Court convicted pharmacist Ahmed Suleiman Ahmed al-Waqi under Articles 19 and 24 of the 2008 Cybercrime Law, adding two years and one year to a three-year Criminal Act sentence, six years in total (per his lawyer).
The article names a 2008 Cybercrime Law under which a court passed sentence; date is the Sunday before the 2026-08-17 publication.
